title: Four places in 40 s, no words
vague: a travel montage of four very different places

answers.places: a Tokyo crossing at night, a Sahara dune at noon, a Norwegian fjord in fog, a Lisbon tram street at golden hour

full: A 40-second vertical (9:16) travel montage in four separate scenes of about 10 seconds each: a Tokyo crossing at night, a Sahara dune at noon, a Norwegian fjord in fog, a Lisbon tram street at golden hour; music, no voice, no text.
